quiet.name: Quiet and precise
quiet.line: Your choices lean towards calm, clear words and careful details. Give people the facts they need, leave room to breathe and let the work speak for itself.
quiet.description: Your choices lean towards calm layouts, clear words and room to breathe. Start with a restrained palette and let one useful detail take the lead.
quiet.say: What you do, what it costs, when it's ready.
quiet.avoid: Vague promises and decoration that gets in the way.
quiet.footer: A starting point for your next design conversation — not a finished brand strategy.

warm.name: Warm and handmade
warm.line: Your choices lean towards a personal welcome and signs of the people behind the work. Use everyday words, show how things are made and help people feel at home.
warm.description: Your choices lean towards personal touches, welcoming language and texture. Start with a characterful typeface and write as if you were greeting someone at the door.
warm.say: Who's behind the work and what someone can expect.
warm.avoid: Invented familiarity or handmade claims you can't back up.
warm.footer: A starting point for your next design conversation — not a finished brand strategy.

bold.name: Bold and direct
bold.line: Your choices lean towards strong contrasts and a message that's hard to miss. Lead with what you offer, keep the words short and make the next step clear.
bold.description: Your choices lean towards strong contrast, confident type and short messages. Start with one headline and one strong colour; give both a clear job.
bold.say: The offer, the benefit and the next step.
bold.avoid: Shouting everything at once or promising more than you deliver.
bold.footer: A starting point for your next design conversation — not a finished brand strategy.
